final_topology.title: Government Isolated Network
final_topology.description: A network for government operations with isolated sensitive systems and secure management workstations.
final_topology.topology_summary: The network will consist of separate zones for standard and sensitive information, with dedicated management workstations and a secure internet gateway for the standard environment.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' (n_new1) that is connected to various nodes and zones, indicating the presence of an asset management system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n_new2) that is connected to various nodes and zones, indicating the presence of a system for documenting data flows.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Standard Environment' (z1), 'Sensitive Environment' (z2), and 'Non-Production Environment' (z5), indicating that data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n1, n2, n5, n_struct4) in various zones, indicating that firewalls are implemented and managed.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n9) and a 'DNS Filtering Server' (n10) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6), indicating that trusted DNS servers are configured.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Gateway' (n_new3) connected to the 'Central AAA Server' (n12), indicating that MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Server' (n10) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6), indicating that DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n11) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6), indicating that network-based URL filters are maintained and enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for different environments and security levels, and various security controls (firewalls, routers, DNS servers, etc.), indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Management System' (n_new4) connected to the 'Central AAA Server' (n12), indicating that network infrastructure is securely managed using IaC.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central AAA Server' (n12) connected to various nodes and zones, indicating centralized network AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Gateway' (n_new3) connected to the 'Central AAA Server' (n12), indicating that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Management Workstations' zone (z3) with dedicated workstations (n3, n4) and a 'Management Router' (n8), indicating dedicated computing resources for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NIDS Sensor' (n13) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6) and 'SIEM' (n17), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n1, n2, n5, n_struct4) and routers (n6, n7) that perform traffic filtering between network segments, as indicated by the links between these nodes.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Gateway' (n_new3) and a 'Remote Device Manager' (n_new5) connected to the 'Central AAA Server' (n12), indicating that access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Network Traffic Logger' (n_new6) connected to the 'SIEM' (n17), indicating that network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'NIPS Sensor' (n14) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6) and 'SIEM' (n17), indicating the deployment of a network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' (n16) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6), indicating the deployment of port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' (n15) connected to the 'Standard Router' (n6), indicating the performance of application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes separate zones for 'Standard Environment' (z1) and 'Non-Production Environment' (z5), indicating that production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'External Penetration Testing Zone' (z6) with a 'Pentest Workstation' (n18) and a 'Penetration Test Scheduler' (n_new7) connected to the 'Pentest Workstation', indicating that periodic external penetration tests are performed.
